identity: The Frostbarrow mines dig where it is coldest and most dangerous; leopards stalk the sled tracks, pinchers hold the icy shore, and a goblin counts stolen blasting powder in the rimewood.

quests.title: Steel for the Work
quests.text: I run Tarncut Mine for The Charter of Stone, and nobody goes under a roof I would not stand beneath myself. Bring me four Steel Bars for the prop fittings. Until those fittings hold, my crew stays out; the stone can wait its turn.

variants.text: I run Tarncut Mine for The Charter of Stone, and nobody goes under a roof I would not stand beneath myself. Bring me four Steel Bars for the prop fittings. Until those fittings hold, my crew stays out; the stone can wait its turn.

The Charter of Stone gives builders my measurements, so a slipped survey mount can become somebody else's crooked bridge. Bring me four Steel Bars to put the mount right. I prefer to discover a mistake while it still fits on a page.

The Charter of Stone's work at Paleroot Cutting rests on roots older than our promises. Bring me four Steel Bars to brace the cutting beside them. We owe the next crew ground that will carry their weight, too.

The Oathdelvers ask me to bring the finds out of Memoryvein Dig with their names still attached. That is difficult when the roof joins the collection. Bring me four Steel Bars for the shoring, and I can keep the stone where it belongs.

The Oathdelvers promised working tools for the next shift, and I intend to put some in their hands. Bring me four Steel Bars for the tools and sorting tables at Redpick Yard. A table that sheds its legs does the sorting badly.

Keeping Reedstone Cut working for The Oathdelvers means persuading water to leave a hole it likes. Bring me four Steel Bars for the worn pump mounts and rods. I have tried a stern word; the water was unmoved.

quests.lesson: The shared steel help of the six mines; each mine leader names the guild in this first offer.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 'Stahl für die Arbeit' (K5 A: Zali's pumps too) and §7: the mine leader's first quest carries the guild membership.

quests.title: Room for Our Feet
quests.text: A driver reaching the landing ought to find somewhere safe to put a foot. Kill six Barnacle Pinchers by day on the {name:icy_shore}. I can guide a sled through bad weather; I cannot signal every crab to mind its manners.

variants.text: A driver reaching the landing ought to find somewhere safe to put a foot. Kill six Barnacle Pinchers by day on the {name:icy_shore}. I can guide a sled through bad weather; I cannot signal every crab to mind its manners.

The shore watch needs a place to stand while the carriers bring their loads through. Kill six Barnacle Pinchers by day on the {name:shell_strand}. My wardens are spending far too much time guarding their ankles.

An observer who looks at the sky cannot also watch every claw at ground level. Kill six Barnacle Pinchers by day on the {name:moonstrand}. I should like the next cry from that post to concern an actual discovery.

The fishers set down their gear and the shore tries to bite it. Kill six Barnacle Pinchers by day in the {name:shallows}, so there is room to work. I have read many signs, but a crab hanging from a fish trap seldom means good fortune.

quests.lesson: The shared shore hunt, by day, at the zone's own shore.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 'Freier Stand am Ufer': Barnacle Pinchers at each zone's shore kind.

quests.title: Something Fresh for the Sled Drivers
quests.text: The sled drivers come back to Tarnwatch Fold with frozen beards and the same hard rations they left with. Bring me five Frost Melons so I can give them something fresh. A meal should occasionally require fewer blows than the journey.
quests.lesson: The zone's first errand, a level only; the early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Hedra Knows the Way Back
quests.text: A driver can know a track for twenty years and lose it in one bad snowfall. Speak to Hedra Rimebell at Rimebell Watch about the trouble our returning sleds are having. She asks which people are missing before she asks what was on the sled.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: Word for Tarncut
quests.text: Kelda Screesort's crew at Tarncut Mine waits on the same sleds that bring our supplies. Go and speak to her about what the mine needs. I can keep a driver warm here, but Kelda knows what must be on the next load.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: The Reliable Light
quests.text: In bad weather, a driver has enough to do keeping hold of the sled. Trim the signal lantern at Rimebell Watch's signal stand and tell me when it is ready. That light is my way of saying we are still here, waiting for them.
quests.completion: Good, a steady light for the next return. I will keep watch; you have given the drivers something to find.
quests.lesson: A use at a place or a day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Coal for the Warming Hut
quests.text: The warming hut at Tarnwatch Fold is for whoever comes back cold, even the ones who insisted they would be fine. Bring me twelve Coal Lumps for its stove. They can explain how fine they are once they can feel their fingers.
quests.lesson: A later errand or use; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: An Explosive Miscalculation
quests.text: Goblin Powder-Counter Nib stole our blasting powder and the Dispatch Folio that travelled with it, blank delivery forms and all. He is counting his takings in the {name:rimewood}, {dir_from_giver:powder_counter_nib}. Kill Nib and bring me the Dispatch Folio. I want the powder theft stopped and those blanks back in our hands before they turn up under somebody's claim on our work.
quests.completion: That is our missing Dispatch Folio: unused delivery forms beside accounts someone has already altered. The blanks went with the stolen powder, so genuine sheets were loose for anyone willing to write a false demand on them. This tells us how they got out; it does not account for every misused paper elsewhere.
quests.lesson: The named leader; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (round60-plan.md §3: A4's prerequisite); its one Accord follow-up is A4. K3 A: the Dispatch Folio, a soulbound quest-only item, drops from Nib every time.

quests.title: Keep Your Head at Splitbolt
quests.text: Borin Splitbolt at Splitbolt Station in Stormvault Heights needs help keeping The Accord's work going under dangerous stone. Speak to him if you are ready for that country. He values someone who notices a loose rock before making a speech beneath it.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The departure id stays; free from 29, it requires nothing (round60-plan.md §2 point 1).

quests.title: Held in Our Name
quests.text: The supports for Tarncut Mine are sitting on this camp's loading ground because a later order claims them as security for somebody else's debt. I raised it with the guild and the army's supply office; both have confirmed the original delivery should go ahead. Secure the dispatch record and release the held load there, then report to Kelda Screesort at Tarncut Mine. Her crew needs those supports, and I want the order that stopped them kept for examination.
quests.completion: The supports are ready for Tarncut again; my crew can have a properly braced roof before work resumes. I recognise that delivery form, but nothing in its proper use authorises this added claim. I will keep the record with the case, so we can examine the demand alongside any evidence of where the forms went.
quests.lesson: Chapter 2 of the story arc (story, may chain).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. A3 (K2 A): the held load at a quest_place socket of the mining camp blueprint.

quests.title: Under a Joint Seal
quests.text: Brodd's held-load record and Nib's Dispatch Folio belong in the same examination. Take our findings to Hadrin Beamset at the Miner's Guild house in Dur Brannoc, so he can compare them with the army's supply records. The right crew must receive its supports, and nobody should be able to attach that invented debt again.
quests.completion: The supply office and I have matched the held-load record to the forms stolen with the powder: Tarncut's order is genuine, but the added claim was never authorised. We have sealed that finding together and will send the correction to the affected crews. The supply routes continue through Toren Waterbarrel at Cinderline Watch in Ashenward March; his work is the next place to follow them.
quests.lesson: Chapter 2 of the story arc (story, may chain).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. A4: wholly band-file data; requires A3 and Nib's free quest (their one Accord follow-up).

quests.title: Two Hands on the Seal
quests.text: The anthracite and garnet orders are filled; this ordinary delivery copy has the guild and military supply office's joint seal on it. Take this delivery copy to Hadrin Beamset at the Miner's Guild house in Dur Brannoc so The Charter of Stone can record it.
quests.completion: That joint seal is ours and the army supply office's: The Charter of Stone confirms the load, and they confirm its place in the supply plan. Both sides put their names to work they can answer for.

quests.notes: Round 58 follow-up of tier 3 (The Charter of Stone): story seed: The player carries an ordinary delivery copy confirmed by the guild and the supply office; the leader explains their joint seal (Charter of Stone) or their joint register marks (Oathdelvers).

quests.title: A Load on Every Back
quests.text: Cliffbucks have taken to charging our haulers between the pines, where there is precious little room to dodge. Hunt eight Cliffbucks by day in the {name:pinewood}, which lies {zone_area:pinewood}. A dwarf can carry a load or climb a tree; asking for both is unreasonable.

variants.text: Cliffbucks have taken to charging our haulers between the pines, where there is precious little room to dodge. Hunt eight Cliffbucks by day in the {name:pinewood}, which lies {zone_area:pinewood}. A dwarf can carry a load or climb a tree; asking for both is unreasonable.

Acorn Hogs keep rooting through the meadow crossings and catching our cart wheels in the holes. Hunt eight Acorn Hogs by day in the {name:meadows}, which lie {zone_area:meadows}. We are trying to run a camp, and lately most of the work has been lifting carts.

Brook Hinds are driving our porters away from the berry woods with more determination than sense. Hunt eight Brook Hinds by day in the {name:berrywoods}, which lie {zone_area:berrywoods}. We need room to carry supplies through, and the animals have declined every reasonable request.

Crescent Stags keep lowering their antlers at anyone carrying timber for the camp. Hunt eight Crescent Stags by day in the {name:eaves}, which lie {zone_area:eaves}. I admire a firm stance until it starts holding up my shift.

Marrow Weevil swarms have made the woods miserable for the crew bringing supplies to camp. Hunt eight Marrow Weevils by day in the {name:bonewood}, which lies {zone_area:bonewood}. I need my workers attending to their loads, not picking beetles out of their joints.

Quaggas keep charging the haulers crossing the plains, and the last load came back scattered over half a field. Hunt eight Quaggas by day on the {name:plains}, which lie {zone_area:plains}. We gave our word that those supplies would reach camp together.

Reed Tapirs have been knocking our porters off their footing beneath the trees. Hunt eight Reed Tapirs by day in the {name:canopy}, which lies {zone_area:canopy}. A dropped bundle is trouble enough before it lands in the water.

quests.notes: Round 58 camp hunt: one shared quest per camp band and clock, given by the camps' foremen; a role near the camp (the camps' level belt L21-23) that the zone's own quests do not hunt yet, met by day.
